output.subject: Q4 forecast: sync before Friday
output.body:
Morning Maya,

Before we lock Q4, please get 30 minutes with Dan (finance) and Lisa this week so the three of you can walk through West and EMEA side by side. Dan wants to pressure-test the commit before it goes in, and Lisa has her numbers ready. I need the final numbers to me by Friday noon so I can roll them into the board pack over the weekend. If anything is slipping, tell me early rather than late.

Tom

output.subject: Thursday 2pm?
output.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the quick reply this morning. Could we do Thursday at 2pm my time (Central) to walk through the co-marketing plan together? I think 45 minutes is enough to settle the webinar topic, the budget split and who owns the landing page. If Thursday doesn't suit, send me a couple of other times this week or next and I'll make one of them work.

Best,
Raj Mehta
Partner Manager, Brightpath Tools

output.subject: Pricing question on the 2027 renewal
output.body:
Hi Maya,

A question ahead of the 2027 renewal. Would Larkspur hold 2026 pricing on fasteners and anchors if we commit to 18 months? We're finalizing our 2027 budget over the next few weeks, and a fixed price on our two biggest categories would make the decision on our side much easier. Happy to talk it through on a call if that's simpler than email.

Have a good weekend,
Dan Reyes
Purchasing Manager, Ridgeway Builders

output.body:
Hi Maya,

You're registered for the Midwest Builders Summit in Chicago on 3–4 November. The Harbor Point block rate ($239) is held until 23:59 Central tonight; after that the hotel releases unsold rooms at its public rate. Please book today, or ask your assistant to book within policy, and we'll handle the rest. Reminder: flights booked fewer than 7 days before departure need manager approval.

Larkspur Travel Desk
